description: Role Overview ------------- A Full Stack .NET Developer proficient in C#, ASP.NET, VB.NET, SQL Server, and front-end technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React. They work across the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptualization and design to deployment and maintenance, ensuring applications are robust, scalable, and user-friendly Key Responsibilities -------------------- Develop and maintain web applications using .NET technologies and front-end frameworks Design and implement server-side logic, APIs, and database integrations Create responsive and interactive user interfaces for multiple devices and browsers Optimize application performance, troubleshoot issues, and debug software Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and other developers to deliver high-quality solutions Technical Skills ---------------- Proficiency in C#, .NET Framework, ASP.NET, SQL Server, front-end frameworks (Angular, React), RESTful APIs, and version control systems like Git
